mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals an impending recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline y-o-y by > 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) rises above 60 for two consecutive months, it signals a strengthening industrial sector that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 60 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, combined with accelerating CPI inflation, signals an overheating economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines > 0.5pp and CPIAUCSL accelerates y-o-y by > 1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 3%, it signals a monetary policy regime that is too accommodative given the inflation backdrop, which will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
